visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages: real broker names, Oregon licenses, transparent-PNG headshots, verbatim Google reviews, and a door to each /team/[slug] profile.
note: PAGE_INVENTORY §6 / PAGE_OUTLINE 2026-09-05. /team is roster only: Breadcrumb, AboutFaces (H1 The brokers, Call/Text, door to each /team/[slug]), Footer. Not a second About. No Proof, no FAQ, no seller ask. Per-broker page: portrait face, license + firm 25/5.0 door, Call/Text/Email, firm proof + firm sales default, personal Atlas/Ledger only when hasRealPersonalRecord. No CMA form; valuation is /sell.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Team. Surface tone (this page opens on cream faces, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFaces
requiredComponents.section: First viewport. Same AboutFaces row as /about. Live brokers from getBrokers, canonical /images/brokers/*.png cutouts at conversation scale. Name is the door to /team/[slug]. Title, Call, and Text sit under the portrait from the live broker phone and title. No card, no wash, no rectangular box. Compact H1 lives here. No eyebrow, no card graf, no seller ask. This is the only roster on the page.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

perBrokerPage.note: PAGE_INVENTORY §6 2026-09-05. Order is Breadcrumb, AboutFaces portrait (not poster), Quiet license + firm review door, V3Doors Call/Text/Email, V3Proof firm reviews, V3Ledger firm sales, personal Instrument/Atlas/Ledger only if hasRealPersonalRecord, Quiet bio + team/reviews/sell. Valuation is /sell; no CMA sheet on this page. Invariants: (1) firm reviews, not a thin personal wall. (2) getBrokerSales still loads the personal set; display is gated. (3) JSON-LD RealEstateAgent + BreadcrumbList. (4) 977 zip filter on firm closings. (5) Direct call/text/email from live phone/email only.
